lines: Hey. We need to talk about that fight.
I went down hard out there. I can take a hit, but I can't keep taking orders like nothing happened.

choices.text: You're right. I'm sorry I let it go that far.
That's part of fighting. Get over it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Next time I'll call you back before things get that bad.

lines: ...All right. I know you didn't mean for me to get hurt.
I'm willing to give it another shot. Just don't forget what you said.
Tch. Then you can go diving without me.
Come back when you're ready to take it seriously.
